PHPMailer — Manual Installation
================================

1. Go to: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases
2. Download the latest release ZIP (e.g. v6.9.3).
3. Extract the ZIP. Inside you'll find a src/ folder containing:
     - PHPMailer.php
     - SMTP.php
     - Exception.php
4. Copy those 3 files into THIS directory's src/ folder:
     vendor/phpmailer/src/PHPMailer.php
     vendor/phpmailer/src/SMTP.php
     vendor/phpmailer/src/Exception.php
5. Done. The mailer.php helper requires these files automatically.
